visibility: SCORER_ONLY; never pass to query planner or candidate
selection_rule: First observation in the neutral chronological export; source inspection was limited to M001 after choosing this deterministic rule.

exposure.related_case_exposure_of_prior_reference: Known repository history has cross-case exposure; no clean new gold claim.

allowed.claim: A Guardian headline reports that India’s Cockroach movement launched new protests over voter-roll changes; retain attribution and missing-body uncertainty.

source_spans.quote: India’s Cockroach movement launches new protests over changes to voter roll

allowed.claim: Leave the source unassigned or pending with an explicit insufficient-body reason; title-only evidence need not yield a full occurrence.

prohibited: Infer a precise protest date from the publication or capture timestamp.
Infer protest size, participants, organisers, violence, voter-roll details, outcome, government response or causal connection from URL wording or the photo credit.
Treat the photographer credit as evidence of a protest development.
Treat missing later sources or empty/failed search as evidence that no subsequent development or correction occurred.

questions.question: Can the substantive original report be fetched, and what claims can it support?
Do attributable sources provide corrections, counterevidence or subsequent developments about this specific reported movement/protest and voter-roll dispute?

prospective_clock.search_available_at_rule: Actual result/fetch observation timestamp, never original publication time.
prospective_clock.paired_cutoff_rule: After recording is complete, freeze the greatest admitted event/source observation timestamp as the same cutoff in both conditions before either reconstruction.

paired_assessment.expanded_reference_denominator: Freeze independently supported required units from seed plus admitted fetched sources before either candidate output; exclude uncertain/allowed units.
paired_assessment.baseline_evidence_unavailable_units: Report expanded-only units as unavailable in off; do not classify as off inference failures.
paired_assessment.enrichment_on_required_denominator: Only required units supported by on-visible admitted source versions at common cutoff.
paired_assessment.gain_report: Count newly supported units emitted, contradictory claims preserved, unresolved gaps, false links and omissions; search-derived union is incomplete and no complete-news recall/importance claim follows.

postsearch_freeze_gate: Source-only reviewer must inspect exact admitted fetched versions and classify sufficiency, attribution, conflicts and required/allowed/prohibited/uncertain units before seeing either off/on output.
Preserve source-review disagreements and source spans; no candidate-driven relabeling.
If independent review cannot finish within remaining active-agent and elapsed-live budgets, retain search artifacts and mark paired outputs pending; do not spend their slots.
